Axiom:
Default: Conventional Commits format `(): `. Alternatives acceptable with documented rationale.
Conventional Commits: - Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `chore`, `refactor`, `test`, `perf`, `build`, `ci`, `style`, `revert`. - Subject: imperative mood, ≤72 chars, no trailing period. - Body (optional): wraps at 100 chars, blank line between subject and body. - Footer: `BREAKING CHANGE: …`, issue refs, sign-off.
Example: `feat(auth): add OAuth2 PKCE flow for native clients`.
Acceptable alternatives (Decision Log entry required): - **plain** — no type prefix, just imperative subject. - **DCO sign-off** — `Signed-off-by: Name ` mandatory for licensing/legal; compatible with conventional commits.
Conventional Commits enables auto-changelog, semantic-release, machine-readable history.
